artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Polyxena
artworks.description: Pittoni's Rococo staging — Polyxena at Achilles' tomb, Neoptolemus and the grieving Trojans, the rite Ovid placed on the Thracian shore before the fleet sailed home.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Polyxena
artworks.description: A second Pittoni version in the Hermitage — the maiden led to the tumulus, the priest's steel, Hecuba's last child taken from her arms.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Polyxena at the Tomb of Achilles
artworks.description: Pittoni's Stuttgart canvas — Achilles' sepulchre in the background, the virgin's voluntary death before the son of the hero whose shade demanded her.
